title: Story premise EDU013: The Traveling Pulse
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (everyday science). Hook: Does the messenger move, or does the message? Takeaway/theme: A wave can transfer a disturbance while local material moves differently.
description: A messenger wants to send a signal along a row of spring-linked blocks, but assumes a marked block must travel to the receiver. The pulse arrives while the marked block oscillates near its starting position.
